company.name: Bloomlife
company.shortDescription: Women's health company redefining maternal care delivery to improve the health of women and babies.
company.description:
Bloomlife is an award winning women’s health company solving the most significant yet underserved global challenges today in maternal health. We are redefining the way maternal care is delivered by combining connected devices with cloud based data analytics to improve access to care, empower women, and provide clinicians with information to more effectively screen and manage pregnancy complications.  Our goal is to become the leading provider of remote care for expectant women globally. 

Bloomlife’s approach to managing high risk pregnancies allows obstetricians to more easily screen maternal and fetal risk, educate the patient, and quickly access high risk specialists regardless of a patient’s geography.  Our solution represents a marked shift from the way high risk pregnancies have been historically assessed using frequent in person appointments, paper logs, and long referral times.

productsAndServices.description: A remote monitoring platform for managing high-risk pregnancies by tracking maternal blood pressure, glucose levels, and fetal health data outside the clinic.
productsAndServices.name: Bloomlife Connects Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Program

productsAndServices.description: A wearable patch device for home use that monitors maternal and fetal heart rates and enables fetal non-stress tests outside clinical settings.
productsAndServices.name: Patch-Based Home Fetal Monitoring Device

productsAndServices.description: A system for deploying standardized and customizable digital surveys to assess mental health and social determinants of health in pregnant patients.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Mental Health and Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) Screening Tools

productsAndServices.description: Customizable integration of Bloomlife’s remote monitoring platform with existing clinical workflows and electronic medical records to streamline maternal care management.
productsAndServices.name: Integrated Clinical Workflow and EMR Integration Services

productsAndServices.description: A billing support system that facilitates reimbursement for remote patient monitoring services related to maternal care through existing CPT codes.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Billing Support for Remote Monitoring Services
